description: This file defines the TransactionManager class, which manages transaction processes such as prepare and commit, handling locks, notifications, and transaction status updates within the Orleans transaction framework.

classes.name: TransactionManager
classes.description: Manages transaction lifecycle including preparation, commit, and ping within Orleans transactions, parameterized by transaction state type.

methods.name: PrepareAndCommit
methods.description: Validates lock, updates transaction record, notifies of abort if invalid, otherwise merges clock and waits for transaction completion.

methods.name: Prepared
methods.description: Handles notification that a participant has prepared for a transaction.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Sends a heartbeat pings for a transaction to ensure liveness.
